units: <cite ref="Makkot 8b:17">Macc. 8ᵇ</cite> sq., a. e. <he>ה׳ שאין בה שוה פרוטה</he> a striking for which no P’rutah can be claimed as damages.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 4:6:3">Y. B. Kam. IV, 4ᶜ</cite> <he>הַכָּיַית מיתה</he> a fatal blow; a. e.—Pl. <he>הַכָּאוֹת</he>. Tanḥ. Thazr. 9 <he>לסבול ה׳</he> to suffer blows.
